brief.topic: Dill pickles bring cold crunch, bright acidity, fresh herbs, and garlicky joy to the table
brief.headline: DILL PICKLES
brief.subtitle: CRUNCH, TANG, AND BRINY JOY

sections.heading: 01 - COLD CRUNCH
lines: Firm cucumbers snap with every bite
Ice-cold spears wake up any sandwich

sections.heading: 02 - BRIGHT BRINE
lines: Vinegar delivers a clean tangy spark
Salt pulls deep flavor into every slice

sections.heading: 03 - DILL MAGIC
lines: Fresh dill makes the jar smell like summer
Garlic and peppercorns finish the party

brief.diagram: A pickle jar in the center connects to four labels: CRUNCH, BRINE, DILL, and GARLIC
brief.footer: KEEP IT COLD. KEEP IT CRISP.
